fields.summary: TC-860-01: Blaze Call Skipped During Audit When All Legs in All DPs Are NonFly Type

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-860

Precondition: A trip exists where all legs in all Duty Periods are of legType NonFly (e.g., SIM, training, ground transportation). The Phase 2 audit must skip the Blaze call for such trips to avoid incorrect pay updates.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip where every leg across all DPs is of legType NonFly (SIM, Training, or Ground Transportation)
Trip: DP1 legs all legType=SIM/Training. DP2 legs all legType=GroundTransportation. No Flying or Deadhead legs in any DP.
Trip record is created in DynamoDB with all legs as NonFly type and auditNeeded=true
Trigger the Phase 2 audit workflow for the all-NonFly trip
Phase 2 audit triggered: all toggles enabled, trip release time passed, auditNeeded=true
Phase 2 audit workflow is invoked
Verify the audit Lambda detects all legs as NonFly and skips the Blaze Pull Lambda call
Phase 2 audit logic check: all legs legType=NonFly
Audit Lambda identifies the all-NonFly condition and bypasses the Blaze Pull Lambda - Blaze is not invoked
Verify the Blaze Pull Lambda CloudWatch logs show no invocation for this all-NonFly trip
CloudWatch Logs for crew-qa2-techp-cmn-blaze-pull Lambda during audit
No Blaze Pull Lambda invocation is logged for the all-NonFly trip during the audit run
Verify the audit completes with a skip or completed status and the COA record reflects no pay change for the all-NonFly trip
DynamoDB audit record and COA Search App after audit for all-NonFly trip
Audit status is set to Completed or Skipped (not Failed) and no pay override is applied for the all-NonFly trip
